raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Dual CCIE Certified (#67013) Network Specialist with 5+ years of experience in with designing, delivering and operating enterprise and cloud-connected infrastructures across large-scale environments. Proven expertise in EVPN-VXLAN, Cisco ACI, hybrid cloud networking, and multi-data-center high availability and optimizing global network performance, resolving outages efficiently, and exceeding customer satisfaction goals. Proven ability to lead teams and ensure adherence to ITIL processes. Possesses expertise in a wide range of technologies including Cisco, Fortinet, Arista, Dell, Versa, Pluribus, PICA8, and cloud platforms. Seeks a challenging Network Architect/Engineer, Data Center Architect/Engineer, Enterprise Infrastructure Architect, Solutions Architect (Networking), Senior Network Engineer or similar role to leverage these skills and contribute to a high-performing team.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Pune, India TECHNICAL SPECIALIST-NGN SHI Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. 08-2024 - Present SHI is a digital transformation company with a security-first approach, leveraging AI, cloud, and automation to solve complex global challenges and optimize IT operations. ● Delivered end-to-end network and security implementations across LAN, WAN, and data-center environments, improving service availability by 30%. ● Reduced recurring LAN/WAN incidents by 35% through structured troubleshooting of STP loops, routing adjacency failures, VLAN access issues and WAN instability. ● Improved mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR) by 40% by creating SOPs, runbooks, and escalation workflows for common network and security failures. ● Strengthened network security posture and audit compliance by reviewing firewall rules, VPN controls, and access segmentation—eliminating unused or risky policies and achieving zero major audit findings. ● Increased proactive fault detection and performance stability by enhancing monitoring thresholds and health validation, preventing multiple user-impacting outages.
ASSOCIATE CONSULTANT/NETWORK ENGINEER New Delhi, India NIVESHAN TECHNOLOGIES INDIA PVT. LTD. 07 2023 – 07-2024 Niveshan is innovative IT leader in Delhi, specializing in core ICT services, datacenter solutions, and certified for quality standards. ● Spearheaded end to end data center’s network planning, implementation, and optimization for a government’s project, achieving a 40% reduction in network downtime and a 15% increase in performance with zero data loss. ● Demonstrated adeptness in L2/L3 network and security hardware, such as 230 Fortinet firewalls and 300 switches, and SDWAN & SDN solutions like Arista Pluribus (Net visor OS), ensuring robust network infrastructure. ● Proficiently handled routing protocols including EIGRP, OSPF, and BGP and for L2 VLAN, STP & LACP network alongside services like Multicast, NAT, ACL, SNMP, NetFlow, SIEM(Syslog) ensuring seamless network operations. ● Orchestrated the successful deployment of end-to-end data center solutions utilizing leading OEM technologies, such as Cisco, Dell, FortiGate, Juniper (Pica8) and Array resulting in enhanced network performance and data security. ● Implemented and managed firewalls to regulate incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predefined security policies, while configuring and overseeing automated network monitoring systems to proactively identify and resolve potential issues.
NETWORK OPERATIONS AND SERVICES ASSOCIATE ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS INDIA PVT. LTD. 02 2022 - 07 2023 Accenture India is a business unit of an Irish-American professional services company based in Dublin, specializing in IT services and consulting. ● Worked closely with cross-functional teams in Asia and Europe for network operation and on time resolution of issues and streamlined client workflows by identifying automation opportunities and spearheading the development of new software tools. ● Bolstered network security by implementing system patches, reducing vulnerabilities by 40%, and leveraging SevOne for comprehensive network monitoring.
Bangalore, India
Optimized network performance for clients by a significant 10% through capacity improvements and fine-tuned SD-WAN configurations with Versa Director, resulting in a smoother user experience. ● Facilitated seamless cloud integration by overseeing the successful integration of over 500 network nodes into a centralized management platform, driving a 20% reduction in maintenance costs. ● Championed process efficiency by conducting LLD reviews, implementing improvements, and saving over 20 hours per week for the team. SUPPORT EXECUTIVE (TECHNICAL) Rajkot, India ISHAN NETSOL PVT. LTD. An Internet Service Provider company with pan-India presence.
03 2020 - 03 2021
Championed predictive and preventive maintenance schedules for telecom equipment (e.g., network switches, Huawei, MircoTik, Ubiquity access points) using monitoring tools like WhatsUp Gold and Zabbix. This minimized downtime and ensured optimal performance. ● Resolved and closed an average of 50+ technical tickets daily, diagnosing and fixing hardware, software, and network issues while maintaining more than 95% customer satisfaction rate. ● Utilized industry-standard monitoring tools (WhatsUp Gold, Zabbix) to proactively identify potential issues within network infrastructure consisting of 2000 network devices. ● Provided expert technical assistance via phone, web, and remote support, exceeding customer expectations and resolving inquiries efficiently. ● Led technology infrastructure upgrades for industry-leading brands (e.g., Huawei, Cisco, Zyxel, MircoTik, Ubiquiti) to incorporate cutting-edge solutions. This resulted in a 30% increase in network efficiency. KEY PROJECT
Implementation of Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC) & Smart Solutions for Safe City Project for one of the largest metropolitan police organizations in the world. ● Working closely with customer in network design workshops to understand customer requirement and their current infrastructure for seamless solution integration. ● Excelled in team projects by collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive project success.
